engine.name: route 2 — local VieNeu clone (~/.venvs/vieneu) with a local WAV reference
engine.note: Only controls read by scripts/gen-voice-clone.py are declared. Every control not in supportedControls is an explicit limitation, never silently ignored. No SSML, no emotion tag, no speed parameter is used anywhere in this packet.

phraseJoinRule: " ".join(phrase.text) must equal voice.proposed.json[key] byte-for-byte; every phrase boundary below falls on a canonical single space. Verified before generation.

benchmark.status: route fixed by the owner/director — nothing pending in this packet
benchmark.selectionAuthority: director-owned decision recorded in brief.md §Identity (voice route 2, slug thanh-long-nang-cao); the owner fixed this voice, no benchmark of other voices was run or is claimed.
benchmark.ownerConfirmationEvidence: brief.md §Identity, written by video-director at Phase 0: 'Voice is fixed by the user — no benchmark of other voices, no change.'
benchmark.referenceFileFacts: exists; md5 199de31c8281d895dd571e36fe464ed5, 8.20 s — director-verified in brief.md §Phase 0. This runtime has no shell tool, so the file was not re-probed by script-agent; the director's verification is quoted, not re-claimed.
benchmark.identity: planningTotal(rate) = SUM(syl/rate) + SUM(in-clip phrase pauses) + SUM(post-clip timeline holds) = SUM(syl/rate) + 1.40 s + 7.20 s = SUM(syl/rate) + 8.60 s
benchmark.planningRateProvenance: brief.md §Identity: the owner asked for a brisk-but-natural read, target +4 %…+8 % over the engine's natural 4.1 syl/s, which is 4.26–4.43. 4.3 is the middle of that mandated band; it is a planning figure, not a measurement.

splitKeys: s3a / s3b — one shot, two keys: the self-blame lands, then the room's silence; the gap between them is a real timeline gap, not punctuation.
s7a / s7b — one shot, two keys: 'Xong rồi.' is its own beat before the celebration; the 0.30 s gap after s7a is the beat.
s8a / s8b — one shot, two keys: the comma in the closing line becomes a real breath, so the gentle instruction is never rushed.
keyPlan.ending: s8b is the last spoken key. Its 3.20 s post-clip hold is the silent ending: no voice, no CTA, only the image and one room sound.

candidatePolicy.note: Seed is left null in every phrase so gen-voice-clone.py may try up to --tries candidates for that phrase only. Pin a seed only after a phrase passes ASR/CER, and record it in voice-report.md.

pauseImplementation: Two declared mechanisms, never punctuation. (1) In-clip phrase pauses: pauseBeforeSeconds / pauseAfterSeconds are real audio gaps written by gen-voice-clone.py (adelay / apad) inside the key's own clip — total 1.40 s across the packet. (2) Post-clip timeline holds: minimumPostClipHoldSeconds is a hold the Reel/timeline layer places after the clip — total 7.85 s, of which 3.20 s is the silent ending. Ellipsis, commas and full stops are never treated as pauses anywhere in this packet.

experimentalCues.note: [cười], [thở dài], [hắng giọng] and similar non-spoken cues stay disabled: no local benchmark proves the installed engine renders them as intended, and gen-voice-clone.py rejects them outright (ACTING_CUE check). They never appear in spoken text or captions.

s1.intent: HOOK + frame-0 cover: name the viewer's room and remove the accusation in one breath. The on-screen text must carry the whole hook with the sound off.
s1.emotion: gentle relief, close, like a friend letting you off — never pity, never a verdict
s1.tempoIntent: brisk on the opening three words, then settle; the second sentence lands slower and stops dead
s1.ending: flat, level — a statement that lands, not a question
s1.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after the clip: the dust keeps turning in the light blade; the figure's shoulder shifts once. Never punctuation.

phrases.text: Ba ngày rồi bạn chưa dọn phòng.
phrases.intent: state a fact the viewer recognises without explaining it

phrases.text: Không phải vì bạn lười.
phrases.intent: take the accusation away, gently, before the viewer can supply it
phrases.tempoIntent: settle and land; no lift on the final word

s2.intent: FIRST PAYOFF: prove the video has seen the viewer's actual room, then name the room's objects in one breath. Nothing more is explained here.
s2.emotion: observational, close, unsurprised — the tone of someone looking around a room with you
s2.tempoIntent: the first sentence is a plain fact and lands at once; the three objects then come one at a time, each slightly lighter than the last
s2.ending: falling — the last object settles the camera and the room
s2.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after the clip: the lateral move finishes on the unmade bed and the duvet edge sags.

phrases.text: Mệt thì cái gì cũng nặng.
phrases.intent: name the reason in the plainest possible words — this is the first payoff and it must be understood, not interpreted

phrases.text: Cốc cà phê nguội trên bàn, quần áo trên ghế,
phrases.intent: inventory the room, in the order the camera shows it

phrases.text: giường chưa được gấp.
phrases.intent: end on the third object, quietly

s3a.intent: show the loop: the room is turned into a verdict on the person. The quoted self-accusation is spoken as the viewer's own inner voice, not as the narrator's opinion.
s3a.emotion: quiet, slightly embarrassed — the tone of repeating something you say to yourself and are ashamed of
s3a.tempoIntent: the setup clause is quick; the quoted words slow down a little because they are being heard for the first time out loud
s3a.ending: flat — the accusation does not want an answer yet
s3a.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after the clip: she looks away from the room; the face-down phone's screen edge glows a thin line.

phrases.text: Nhìn cả căn phòng,
phrases.intent: put the viewer physically in the room, looking

phrases.text: bạn tự nói trong đầu: mình lười thật.
phrases.intent: speak the viewer's own accusation in the viewer's own words
phrases.tempoIntent: slows slightly on the quoted clause; level, no rising

s3b.intent: land the depleted state in plain physical words — tired, not lazy. No diagnosis, no clinical term, no statistic.
s3b.emotion: flat, resigned, unbothered — a fact, not a confession
s3b.tempoIntent: first clause plain and low; second clause slightly slower, with the fatigue audible in the pace rather than in the words
s3b.ending: trailing, no lift — nothing is being promised
s3b.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after the clip: the face-down phone buzzes once against the sheet — a muffled vibration — and its screen line flickers once.

phrases.text: Rồi bạn cũng chỉ nằm xuống thôi.
phrases.intent: say what actually happened, without judging it

phrases.text: Cả ngày mệt, tối chẳng muốn động gì.
phrases.intent: name the cause in the plainest possible words

s4.intent: RE-HOOK: turn the room from judge into witness. The 'đâu' at the end is the whole point — a gentle contradiction, said like someone who knows the viewer well.
s4.emotion: warm, assured, slightly playful at the edge — never smug
s4.tempoIntent: one clause, unhurried; the final 'đâu' lifts slightly and falls back
s4.ending: falling on 'đâu', leaves the room's answer open for the next key
s4.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after the clip: the pull-back settles and the whole room sits still for a beat.

phrases.text: Căn phòng này không nói gì về bạn đâu.
phrases.intent: the re-hook — the room stops judging you
phrases.tempoIntent: unhurried, one clause, gentle rise on 'đâu' then fall

s5.intent: answer the re-hook and state the thesis in plain words. The hedge 'Có lẽ' is mandatory: research.md §8.1 requires the link between a depleted state and a messy room to be spoken as the narrator's reading, never as a finding (no study measures it).
s5.emotion: plain, factual, almost tender underneath — an explanation offered, not a verdict
accentWords: không còn sức làm một việc nhỏ nữa
s5.tempoIntent: 'Có lẽ nó nói:' is a quiet turn, not a certainty; the middle clause is level; the last clause slows and lands with the emphasis on 'thôi'
s5.ending: flat and settled on 'thôi' — the promise the whole video has been making
s5.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after the clip: her shoulders drop half a centimetre; the lamp switch is under her fingertip but not pressed yet.

phrases.text: Có lẽ nó nói:
phrases.intent: open the answer as the narrator's own reading — the hedge is the honesty, not a weakness
phrases.tempoIntent: brief, a breath with a turn in it; 'Có lẽ' must not be rushed

phrases.text: hôm nay bạn không còn sức làm một việc nhỏ nữa.
phrases.intent: say the depleted state in plain words, without any clinical word
emphasis: không còn sức làm một việc nhỏ nữa

phrases.text: Nó nói về hôm nay thôi.
phrases.intent: the thesis in six syllables: today, not your life

s6.intent: THE PAYOFF: name the one small act exactly, so the viewer can see it and check it. 'chỉ' carries the whole promise.
s6.emotion: light, easy, almost casual — the smallness is the point, so the voice must not make it sound like a mission
accentWords: chỉ gấp một cái áo lên
s6.tempoIntent: brisk and practical through the first clause; the destination slows a touch so the eye can follow it
s6.ending: settles — the act is done, the sentence is done
s6.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after the clip: the desk lamp has clicked on and its warm pool blooms over the desk, the cold cup and the newly flat shirt.

phrases.text: Hôm nay, chỉ gấp một cái áo lên,
phrases.intent: name the single small act
emphasis: chỉ gấp một cái áo lên

phrases.text: đặt lên lưng ghế.
phrases.intent: say where it goes, so the viewer can watch it land

s7a.intent: a single satisfied syllable after the act — the beat the split key exists to create.
s7a.emotion: quiet satisfaction, almost a small exhale
s7a.tempoIntent: short, unhurried, with the natural drop at the end of a finished action
s7a.ending: falls away — it must leave room for the celebration that follows
s7a.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after the clip: the folded shirt lies flat on the chair back and the lamp light moves across it as she straightens.

phrases.text: Xong rồi.
phrases.intent: mark the finished act

s7b.intent: THE CLIMAX: celebrate the small thing without teaching it. The celebration is stated, not suggested, because the user's own theme is 'mừng từng việc nhỏ'.
s7b.emotion: warm — the warmest read in the video, and still not loud
s7b.tempoIntent: first clause light and quick; 'Nhưng' opens the turn; the last clause slows a little so the celebration lands rather than snaps
s7b.ending: settles and holds — the voice does not fall away into a fade
s7b.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after the clip: the camera drifts back; the room with the lamp pool and the folded shirt is held.

phrases.text: Một việc nhỏ thôi.
phrases.intent: keep it small on purpose — do not inflate the act

phrases.text: Nhưng hôm nay, việc đó đáng mừng.
phrases.intent: celebrate it out loud — this is the payoff of the whole video
phrases.tempoIntent: slows on the last clause and lands

s8a.intent: open the one light closing line the brief allows. It must sound like an aside from a friend, not like advice.
s8a.emotion: quiet, practical, unemphatic — it is the softest line in the video
s8a.tempoIntent: unhurried; the clause is set up and left open, because the gap after it is real silence
s8a.ending: rests on the comma — the sentence is not finished and does not pretend to be
s8a.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after the clip: she is still at the window, her hand on the curtain edge; the room is quiet.

phrases.text: Nếu mệt kéo dài mấy tuần,
phrases.intent: open the condition, without dramatising it

s8b.intent: the last words of the video: say it to one person, then stop. No hotline, no number, no follow, no comment — the brief allows this one line and nothing else.
s8b.tempoIntent: one calm clause, no lift on the final word — the instruction must not sound like a call to action
s8b.ending: level, and simply stops. The 3.20 s hold after it is the real ending.
s8b.postClipHoldPolicy: SILENT ENDING — no voice, no CTA, no music swell. In this hold the curtain is drawn fully open and the late-afternoon light floods the room; the folded shirt on the chair back catches it. Only room sound (fabric on the rail); BGM has already cut on the last word.

phrases.text: hãy nói với một người bạn tin.
phrases.intent: the one light closing line — say it and stop
